text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. When you type a question into a search engine, NLP breaks down your words to grasp their meaning, not just the letters. It powers translation tools, allowing you to convert a sentence from English to Spanish in seconds. NLP also performs sentiment analysis, which can tell if a product review is positive, negative, or neutral by examining word choices. Finally, it is the technology behind chatbots, enabling them to respond helpfully to customer questions online. By combining grammar rules with machine learning, NLP makes communication between people and machines more natural every day.
